basic_profile.bio: Avid fantasy hockey enthusiast and strategy gamer based in Denver, Colorado. I spend my free time analyzing NHL stats and perfecting my Creeper World 4 strategies. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, where I manage a local outdoor gear store. Recently single, I enjoy exploring the Rockies with my camera and sharing my shots on the Coloradophotography subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been playing fantasy hockey for the past three seasons, drawing on a lifelong passion for the sport and a knack for statistical analysis. My knowledge comes from years of watching games, reading player analyses, and engaging in online forums. I'm also self-taught in strategy gaming, particularly enjoying the challenge of tower defense games like Creeper World 4.
